title: Let's Build a Huney Crafter
description:
A simple automated honey crafter designed to work perfectly with honey farms. Consumes 4000 honey bottles per hour at max speed. Be sure to let me know what you think of autocrafting, the more poeple who switch on the more pressure we put on devs to implement it.

Crafter Schematic in case you wanted to build:
http://www.mediafire.com/file/cpi9m19m5hfc4qe/Huney_Crafter.litematic/file
